Lisbon long weekend
Dates: 1-5 October 2026
Stay: Casa Alfama guesthouse, Rua dos Remedios (booking ref LX-88213)

Day 1: arrive 11:20, check in, evening walk up to Miradouro da Graca.
Day 2: Belem tower, the monastery and pasteis de nata. Tram 28 back.
Day 3: day trip to Sintra; buy train tickets from Rossio the day before.
Day 4: LX Factory in the morning, sunset at Cais do Sodre.
Day 5: fly home 13:45.

Practical:
- Get a Viva Viagem card for trams and the metro.
- Restaurants: book dinner after 20:00.
- Bring comfortable shoes, the hills are steep.

Before leaving home:
- Check in online 24 hours before the flight and download the boarding passes.
- Water the plants and ask the neighbour to take in the post.
- Turn the heat pump down to 16 degrees and switch off the espresso machine.
- Euro cash for the first day; cards work almost everywhere.
